waypoints.name: Maroon Lake Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From Aspen, drive west on Highway 82 to the roundabout, turn onto Maroon Creek Road and follow it about 9.5 miles to the Maroon Lake parking area at the road end. In summer the road is closed to private vehicles during the day, so plan on a parking reservation or the shuttle from Aspen; a fee is charged at the entrance station.

waypoints.name: Pyramid Peak
waypoints.directions: Take the Crater Lake trail about 1.5 miles to the junction near 10,100 ft and turn left onto the Pyramid Peak trail, which climbs steeply to the amphitheater below the north face. Cross the rock glacier on a faint cairned path, climb about 1,000 ft of loose scree to the northeast ridge saddle near 13,000 ft, then follow cairned ledges, the green wall and the west-side gullies to the summit.
